walk: the girl walks forward along the path at an easy pace, arms swinging gently
jump: the child jumps up high with both feet off the ground and lands softly, arms up
cry: the boy cries, tears running, and rubs his eye with the back of his hand
dance: the child dances joyfully, swaying, turning a little and lifting one knee to the rhythm
sing: the child sings happily with the mouth opening and closing, small colourful musical notes float out of the mouth and drift up
clap: the child claps both hands together again and again, smiling
swim: the boy swims forward through the pool water with steady arm strokes, splashing gently
talk: the child talks, mouth moving as if explaining something, one hand gesturing
look: the child looks through the binoculars, turning slowly from side to side
open: the child pulls the door handle and the door swings open
close: the child pushes the door and it swings shut
write: the child writes in the exercise book, the pencil moving across the page
play: the children play with the ball, kicking it to each other and laughing
fisherman: the fisherman throws the round net out over the river and it spreads open in the air
